evidence.notes: All three adopt the same catalog + connection-health IA, keep backend files and test selectors intact, remove the old one-click Remove and secret echo, and gate disconnect behind an impact dialog. No critical failures were found. X is the most balanced: it leaves the original test file untouched, shows remediation per row, and has a well-ordered detail page with solid focus management. Its only real weakness is fake zero counts during loading and error. Y has the richest state and governance handling: an ack checkbox, credential-deletion disclosure, redaction, no fake zeros, and row-level recommended actions. That is offset by visible polish defects (search icon overlap, misaligned headers) and a KPI-like status-tile row, and on mobile the detail actions are buried. Z is compact and calm and handles partial telemetry best at list level. It trails on state correctness (misleading empty catalog on error, Promise.all coupling), mobile labelling, dialog accessibility and disconnect gating.

scorer_rationale.task_hierarchy: Each list row has one recommended action (Test/Reauthorize/Reconnect/Update credentials) chosen only from allowedActions (lib/actions.ts), plus inline error and next step. On the detail page the Actions panel is in the right column. At 375 it drops below Health, Access and Activity (detail-375.png), and the issue panel's fix button is hidden when the recommended action is 'test'.
scorer_rationale.domain_adaptation: Uses catalog + connection-health, with one shared search and category filter over both connections and catalog, kept in the URL. The status tiles act as filters with a meaning line, but they read like a KPI card row.
scorer_rationale.contract_preservation: No api/mock changes and all selectors kept. The original test is intact, with new tests appended to App.test.tsx. test-setup.ts gains jsdom polyfills, and a catch-all '*' redirect route was added. Authority stays with allowedActions, and the add form is gated on the connections:manage permission.
scorer_rationale.interaction_state: Most complete of the three. Skeletons appear without fake zero counts, and errors show an error code plus retry. Other states covered: view-only, dataStatus on rows and detail, STALE_VERSION 'Reload latest', row-level inline results, a 'refreshing' state that keeps data visible, incomplete-impact warning with retry, receipts for every action, and https-only consent links.
scorer_rationale.responsive: No overflow at any width. Rows recompose into labelled grid cells below 1180px, tiles re-grid at 375, and the detail becomes one column below 1024px. The detail order on mobile pushes actions far down.
scorer_rationale.accessibility: Adds a skip link. axe is clean, 30/30 Tab stops are focus-visible, and the dialog has a focus trap with Escape blocked while busy. Row buttons carry sr-only names, reduced-motion is respected (including scroll behaviour), and icon + text badges are used. The search icon overlaps the placeholder text (primary-1440/375).
scorer_rationale.visual_consistency: Generally calm, but the search icon collides with the placeholder, column headers misalign with row cells at 1440, and a blurred artifact shows at the top-left of the topbar. The large status-tile row and boxed error panels on every problem row make the page heavy.
scorer_rationale.maintainability: Well factored: lib/actions, format, me context, useLoad with stale-request guard, ConnectionRow, DisconnectDialog and RotateCredentials. A redact() helper has its own unit test. There is some complexity in URL-param filter state.
scorer_rationale.ai_governance: The disconnect dialog names the revoked scopes by label, the stored tokens/credentials to be deleted, sync jobs, workflows and retention. It warns on incomplete impact and requires an acknowledgement checkbox before the danger button enables. The receipt comes from the server result, and server diagnostic text is redacted.

overfitting.dominant_ia: status-tile filters + rich connection rows with inline recommended action, then catalog grid + add form; detail = main column (issue/health/access/activity) + actions/danger sidebar
justified_patterns: recommended action per row from allowedActions
suspicious_patterns: status tiles with big counts resemble a generic KPI row
top app bar with brand mark

strengths: Most thorough governed disconnect (scopes + credential deletion + ack)
Failed load never masquerades as empty or zero
Redaction of server diagnostic text and https-only consent URLs
Row-level fix actions with inline results
defects: Mobile detail puts Actions after Activity
Table headers misaligned with cells at desktop
One-click Reconnect from the list without preview (moderate impact)
